subject: indiv-td
title: (R)INDIV.TD.------SOC.RT.
description: First of two diagrams in BK(NM)-29 (Black Notated Music, Level One). The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'seriousness of creative transformation — not to mention rebuilding. The reality implication of affinity alignment is not a joke. To view these questions is to begin looking at the heart of creativity.' The crossing diagrams how the reality of individual tendencies structurally meets social-reality at the affinity-alignment-rebuilding scale: (R)INDIV-TD (the reality of individual tendencies) crossed with SOC-RT (social reality — the partner-axis's receiving conditions). INDIV-TD sits on the left with the subject-arrow; PHY-U-P (physical-universe particulars) labels the line that rises from the main line to INFO-DY (information dynamics) at upper-right, with INFO-DS (information dissemination) branching from INFO-DY. SOC-RT sits centrally as partner-axis. (R)ATTN (the reality of attraction) branches from INFO-DS, with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branching from ATTN at the right margin. COS-PP drops from the main line below INDIV-TD, with AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and A-PR (all-purpose) branching from it; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) drops from the main line at the center. Structural argument: when individual tendencies is crossed with social-reality, the upper diagonal PHY-U-P → INFO-DY → INFO-DS is the *informational-dissemination route* — physical-universe particulars route through information-dynamics into information-dissemination, the partner-side's working channel for individual-tendencies.
